question: Below what share of rated capacity does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life under the USABC standard?
rendered: According to the document, under the US Advanced Battery Consortium (USABC) standards, an EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity is less than 80% of the rated capacity.
